test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Irrespective of the chaos in the classroom, our class teacher stays __cool as a cucumber__.

options.text: Scolds all the students in the classroom

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cool as a cucumber"** means someone who remains calm and composed, even in difficult or stressful situations. (शांत और संयमित)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the argument going on around him, he stayed** cool as a cucumber.**
 
 
 
• **"Calm and composed" **refers to someone who is not agitated or disturbed and maintains their tranquility. (शांत और संयमित)
 
 
• **Example: **She remained **calm and composed **during the entire interview process.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is **'Irrespective of the chaos in the classroom, our class teacher stays Stays calm and composed'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Behaves like a vegetable **(सब्जी की तरह व्यवहार करना): Refers to someone who is inactive or unresponsive.

 
 
• **Example:** After the accident, he was in a coma and **behaved like a vegetable.**
 
 
 
• **Scolds all the students in the classroom **(कक्षा में सभी छात्रों को डांटना): Refers to reprimanding or rebuking all students.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher **scolds all the students in the classroom** for not completing their homework.
 
 
 
• **Develops a fever** (बुखार हो जाना): Refers to someone who becomes sick and has a high body temperature.
 
 
• **Example:** He **develops a fever** whenever he gets too stressed.
